projects.name: agent-platform
projects.purpose: Central Python-first platform project for building, configuring, evaluating, and improving agents.
projects.scope: Reusable platform models, agent specs, evaluation helpers, planning helpers, open-source evaluation, and platform docs.
boundaryNotes: Platform-wide reusable capabilities can live here when they are part of the central agent platform.
Domain-specific experiments should become separate root projects instead of being added to agent-platform by default.

projects.name: presentation-agent
projects.purpose: Presentation-focused agent project for collecting presentation design references, PPT/HTML sources, reusable assets, and script-flow evidence.
projects.scope: Presentation reference catalogs, project-specific presentation research, PPTX-to-HTML conversion helpers, presentation asset storage policy, and future presentation script/flow agents.
boundaryNotes: Keep presentation-specific data, conversions, and generated artifacts inside presentation-agent/.
Store raw PPT/PPTX/assets only after project-local license review.
Reusable presentation reference curation behavior is tracked as a skill under _skills/.

projects.name: platform-desktop-app
projects.purpose: Desktop/installable software productization project for turning the workspace platform into an end-user application with OS-specific installer, release, privacy, and update gates.
projects.scope: Desktop product boundary, distribution registry, packaging strategy, installer release gates, project-local requirements/specs, and future desktop shell implementation.
boundaryNotes: End-user installer packaging belongs here, not in agent-platform install_mode setup profiles.
Reuse workspace-monitor as the initial UI candidate unless desktop-specific research proves a separate UI is easier to maintain.
Do not bundle real secrets, private snapshots, or environment-specific tokens in installers.
Actual Tauri, Electron, or packager dependency installation must follow the installation audit workflow.

projects.name: workspace-monitor
projects.purpose: Vercel-deployable Next.js monitoring site that visualizes repository history, projects, agents, requirements, specs, evaluations, and Markdown documents from a generated workspace snapshot.
projects.scope: Project-local Next.js UI, repository snapshot generator, generated monitor data, deployment docs, tests, and monitor-specific requirements/specs.
boundaryNotes: Keep monitor UI code, data collection scripts, generated snapshots, and deployment settings inside workspace-monitor/.
Read shared repository documents as data sources; do not move source histories or project docs into the monitor project.
Before deploying publicly, review generated snapshots for private data and regenerate only the documents intended for public visibility.

agentCatalog.name: cli-pipeline-agent
agentCatalog.description: Checks multi-process CLI orchestration plans before several external CLIs are launched, piped, exchanged through files/artifacts, merged, or cancelled together.
agentCatalog.trigger: before implementing or closing work that starts multiple CLI processes, connects stdout/stderr/stdin pipes, exchanges files/temp artifacts/caches/logs/reports, fans out/fans in CLI work, or embeds CLI orchestration in a desktop shell, monitor, local daemon, or agent workflow

agentCatalog.name: coding-research-agent
agentCatalog.description: Performs coding-focused research across web, docs, repositories, papers, package registries, and code before implementation.
agentCatalog.trigger: before API, library, architecture, bug root cause, performance, security, migration, testing, or implementation-pattern research becomes code work

agentCatalog.name: config-contract-agent
agentCatalog.description: Checks whether shared JSON settings files explain their references, structure rules, and important fields inside the file itself.
agentCatalog.trigger: after creating or changing shared JSON settings under agent-platform/configs/

agentCatalog.name: deep-research-agent
agentCatalog.description: Validates multi-step deep research packages and prepares detailed source-grounded reports with citation audit requirements.
agentCatalog.trigger: when a user asks for deep research, a detailed report, a landscape review, or a multi-source evidence synthesis that should become a durable report

agentCatalog.name: example-python-agent
agentCatalog.description: Minimal Python-first agent spec used to verify the platform skeleton.

agentCatalog.name: hallucination-guard-agent
agentCatalog.description: Extracts factual claims from an answer or artifact and checks whether each claim is grounded, verified, or explicitly caveated.
agentCatalog.trigger: before publishing final answers, docs, plans, or evaluations that contain factual claims

agentCatalog.name: knowledge-skeptic-agent
agentCatalog.description: Assumes knowledge-base content can be outdated, incomplete, or wrong and validates references before reuse.
agentCatalog.trigger: before using _research, _docs, _history, or other knowledge-base content as evidence

agentCatalog.name: memory-bootstrap-agent
agentCatalog.description: Checks durable repository memory anchors so future agent sessions load the correct operating context before work.
agentCatalog.trigger: at the beginning of a non-trivial session after web-first intake, and after durable rules or navigation settings change

agentCatalog.name: omission-guard-agent
agentCatalog.description: Checks that required user instructions, requirements, artifacts, and acceptance checks are explicitly covered before close-out.
agentCatalog.trigger: before closing non-quick work or whenever missed requirements are a material risk

agentCatalog.name: parallel-work-planner-agent
agentCatalog.description: Plans safe parallel lanes from task dependencies, file/resource boundaries, coordination targets, and merge verification.
agentCatalog.trigger: when speed matters, work can be decomposed, or multiple agents/lane-style tasks may run at the same time

agentCatalog.name: requirements-manager-agent
agentCatalog.description: Turns user requests into reviewed requirements and keeps requirements linked to implementation and evaluation.
agentCatalog.trigger: before meaningful work that changes expected behavior, operating rules, project structure, or platform capability

agentCatalog.name: research-insight-planner-agent
agentCatalog.description: Core Perplexity-style research agent that retrieves, ranks, extracts, synthesizes, cites, and skeptically verifies evidence before creating an execution plan.
agentCatalog.trigger: before planning work that benefits from current external knowledge, prior repository knowledge, or multiple references

agentCatalog.name: resource-guard-agent
agentCatalog.description: Checks memory and runtime resource leak risks for agents, servers, browser automation, workers, caches, streams, and large-data tasks.
agentCatalog.trigger: before closing work that touches long-running runtimes, background workers, browser automation, subprocesses, caches, streams, large-data processing, file handles, network connections, timers, or subscriptions

agentCatalog.name: skill-lifecycle-agent
agentCatalog.description: Creates, validates, tracks, and improves repository-managed Codex skills with explicit validation and forward-test loops.
agentCatalog.trigger: when creating, updating, validating, installing, or improving a custom Codex skill

agentCatalog.name: spec-driven-planner-agent
agentCatalog.description: Turns requirements into spec-driven artifacts and keeps specs linked to plans, tasks, validation, and traceability.
agentCatalog.trigger: before meaningful work that changes behavior, structure, platform capability, or implementation criteria

agentCatalog.name: spec-reconciliation-agent
agentCatalog.description: Classifies ambiguous specs and spec/source mismatches, then emits user-answerable clarification alerts when the agent should not guess.
agentCatalog.trigger: when an active spec is ambiguous, missing important acceptance criteria, or differs from current source, tests, generated artifacts, or docs

agentCatalog.name: work-evaluator-agent

requirements.requirement: The repository shall operate as a long lived monorepo for a personal agent building platform and multiple projects.
Meaningful changes shall be committed and pushed to origin/main immediately.
Every new user instruction shall start with web search and leave a public search record.
User requests shall be saved as meaning summaries and connected to artifacts, evaluations, and commits through request to outcome traces.
Requirements shall be derived from user work, reviewed, changed, baselined, and used as the basis for implementation and evaluation.
Meaningful work shall leave work summaries, plan records, evaluation reports, and detailed history.
Completed work shall be evaluated against the initial instruction and requirements, and gaps shall be reworked.
Sessions shall verify memory bootstrap anchors so the AI does not rely on chat memory.
Coding work should default to Python first, research first, and open source review first.
Final factual outputs shall be grounded, and knowledge base content shall be treated as fallible.
Active agents and parallel work should be visible in one coordination board.
Project specific artifacts shall stay inside the owning project; only shared assets should be promoted to folders.
Meaningful implementation work shall pass through spec, plan, tasks, validation, and traceability artifacts, similar to spec driven development.
Custom skill creation and updates shall leave explicit source, trigger examples, validation, forward tests, improvement backlog, and evaluation targets.
Before writing source code, agents shall research best fit architectures and reference architectures, then record at least two structure candidates and the decision rationale.
Large company engineering, official research lab, architecture center, and high signal independent source lists shall be managed in a registry separate from the general source taxonomy.
Material source values, config values, claims, review signals, assumptions, and planning constraints shall be traced to sources and access dates, and material plan steps shall be linked to evidence.
Web search shall behave more like human research by using broad global tech blogs, Korean big tech blogs, India technology sources, paper discovery sources, and Korean local review channels.
For Korean user review or local market decisions, research shall prioritize Naver Map, Kakao Map, Naver Blog/Search, and official pages, then evaluate candidate page quality.
The workspace shall select quick , standard , ship first , research , or governance mode based on work type, and manage required artifacts plus deferred improvements differently by mode.
Coding research shall record stack specific official docs or standards, version constraints, high signal issue/discussion sources, and community signal interpretation.
Coding research shall record maintainable language/runtime selection, separate architecture theory from practitioner opinions, and record folder structure candidates plus folder semantics.

When speed matters or work can split into independent lanes, agents shall validate dependencies, touch paths, conflict controls, coordination targets, and merge/rollback strategy before parallel execution.

When multiple research lanes run in parallel, agents shall use a merge gate that waits for all research lanes, synthesizes contradictions and accepted evidence, and releases downstream implementation only after acceptance checks pass.

The platform shall allow Slack, Discord, and Microsoft Teams notifications to be enabled or disabled through config while real tokens or webhook URLs are injected by the user through environment variables.
Root folder structure shall be classified as registered projects, reserved operational folders, local only folders, or generated outputs, and root structure changes shall pass a deterministic audit.
Durable top level folders in registered projects shall be explained in the project registry, and generated output patterns shall be verified against .gitignore .

The repository's AI assistant operating principles shall not be locked to Codex; they shall be managed as tool agnostic principles plus thin runtime adapters usable from Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, or another assistant tool preferred by the user.

Marketing, consumer insight, market sizing, brand/GTM, book/theory, survey, and quantitative evidence research shall use marketing evidence profile.json to separate evidence lanes for books/academic work, survey methodology, public statistics, market reports, and platform behavior data, and every numeric evidence point shall record value, unit, base, geography, timeframe, population, methodology, sample, sponsor, and comparability notes.

When a project spec is ambiguous or differs from current source, tests, or artifacts, agents shall record comparison evidence before implementation and classify each issue as update spec , update source , ask user , or defer . ask user issues shall be surfaced as clarification needed alerts with stable question IDs, options, answer format, and decision impact, and the related spec or source shall not be changed until the answer is recorded.

docs/ shall be managed through the instructions , policies , operating models , and governance categories, and docs/registry.json plus docs audit shall validate allowed root files, category placement, required documents, and Korean/English companions so new documents do not sprawl at the root or go missing.

Repository wide navigation and health checks shall use source of truth files such as ops/projects/root structure policy.json , ops/projects/registry.json , and docs/registry.json , and shall expose root folder class/source plus core audits and tests from one place.
Repository operations CLIs shall separate human readable output from automation oriented JSON output and provide category filters so maintainers can run only the checks they need.

When repository operations tools grow, they shall not mix CLI, domain models, check definitions, execution, and serialization in one script; they shall be split into responsibility focused modules while preserving existing command compatibility.
Durable names for projects, tools, skills, docs, specs, history, configs, and source code shall be managed by namespace specific rules and pass deterministic naming audit after changes.

The platform concept and operating philosophy shall be reviewed periodically, and user authority, scoped autonomy, rollback capability, security/privacy, operating cost, and agentic debt shall be reflected in philosophy and memory bootstrap.

The platform shall provide a detailed first read identity description in main entry points and operating model docs, covering purpose, problem solved, core loop, accumulated assets, project boundaries, and the value of evidence backed evaluation.

New coding projects shall be bootstrappable from technology specific blueprints with a dry run plan first, optional root project registration, project local README/docs/specs/configs/tests/tools/artifacts, official doc checklists, and coding research connection points.

Meaningful work shall record phase level duration under history/work timings/ , and the coordination board, Workspace Monitor, and evaluation input shall make the slowest phase and bottleneck candidates visible.

When a situation requires deep research, deep research agent shall record multiple search channels, iterative research steps, source quality review, evidence items, contradiction mapping, citation audit, report outline, and report targets before treating a long form report as ready to write.

When search quality matters, agents shall search like a careful human researcher by using query ladders, search operators, source lanes, regional/community/contrary searches, snowballing, and selective summary capture; good sources are summarized only when reusable.

When the user wants to use AI better or an AI use gap appears during work, the platform shall diagnose it as a context, task fit, iteration, verification, tooling, or asset promotion gap rather than a personal flaw, then apply the smallest useful bridge intervention.

If a user instruction is vague, biased, leading, conclusion seeking, missing a checkable output contract, or assumes an LLM is a deterministic truth machine, agents shall rewrite it into a neutral task brief with goal, context, constraints, output format, success criteria, counterevidence, and verification path before execution.

Prompting strategy shall vary by model capability and type. For weak, non reasoning, or uncertain models, agents shall use two independent attempts or a draft critique revise loop when cost and latency allow and task variance is high, then compare and merge results. For stronger reasoning models, agents shall prioritize clear goal, context, constraints, and verification over unnecessary duplicate calls. Repeated model agreement is not factual proof and must be checked through sources, tests, tools, evaluators, or human judgment.

The platform's ultimate purpose is to keep reducing repetitive human work, create more efficient methods, and reduce elapsed work time. Agents shall observe human research, judgment, execution, and verification processes; model them as reproducible steps; and promote valuable repetition into prompts, workflows, templates, tools, skills, agents, or project features. Automation must preserve human judgment checkpoints, verification, and rollback boundaries.

Vague user instructions are a major cause of poor results, so agents shall ask clarifying counter questions when needed to specify goal, context, constraints, output contract, and success criteria. However, clarification must not become an endless loop: agents shall apply a clarification budget , usually one round and at most two rounds, with no more than three prioritized questions per round. If the answer is missing or remains vague, the agent shall converge by using reasonable assumptions, option based defaults, ship first then confirm, or explicit deferral.

A pending user answer or clarification needed item shall not stop all work. Agents shall isolate only the decision or artifact that truly depends on the missing answer as a blocked decision , while continuing unaffected research, source collection, option comparison, drafting, testing, validation, documentation, and risk analysis. The assumptions, defaults, deferred items, and merge or correction path after the answer arrives shall be recorded as unblocked work , assumptions , and resume action .

Multiple blocked decision , clarification needed , approval, or preference decisions shall be collected in a central human decision inbox instead of being scattered through chat. Each item shall include a stable ID, question/options, answer format, dependent work, still unblocked work, notification event, interrupt policy , checkpoint required , and resume action . When the human returns with an answer, the agent shall checkpoint current work safely, then either interrupt and resume the affected task based on priority and risk or schedule it at the next safe point, updating the inbox state.

Platform installation shall be managed with install mode , separate from work mode . user install shall provide a minimal regular/runtime path for using the platform, viewing artifacts, and running or deploying the monitor. developer install shall provide editable installs, devDependencies, tests, and governance checks for improving the platform, editing source, changing validation harnesses, or changing shared rules. If install commands are actually run and dependency or environment state changes, the existing installation audit rules shall apply.

When productizing the platform as end user installable desktop software, the work shall be owned by the separate platform desktop app/ root project. End user installer packaging shall be separated from repository setup install mode , and shall record Tauri/Electron/native packaging comparison, OS installer formats, signing/notarization, update, uninstall/rollback, secret/privacy handling, dependency/license review, and installer smoke test release gates.

Language and runtime choices for platform components shall not globally prefer Python, TypeScript/Next.js, Rust/Tauri, Go, or Electron. They shall be selected by component boundary and measured bottleneck. Defaults are Python for agent logic, TypeScript/Next.js for UI, Rust/Tauri for desktop shell/native command boundaries, Go for local daemons/CLIs, and Electron as fallback. Before moving to Rust or Go, record bottleneck metrics, prototype measurements, release gates, and rollback plan.

Runtime and language choices shall not stop at research; they shall continue into design. Choices involving Rust, Go, Tauri, Wails, Electron, Python, or TypeScript/Next.js shall research official docs, architecture/ADR references, open source implementations, issue/discussion signals, and contrary cases; compare at least two candidate designs; record an ADR style decision; write a prototype measurement plan; and record installation audit/rollback planning before implementation or dependency installation.

Even as the platform becomes installable, it must not depend on one CLI, AI assistant CLI, package manager, deployment CLI, or vendor shell. The installable platform provides the workspace, history, docs, evaluation, settings, UI, and orchestration layer; external CLIs attach as replaceable adapters with availability, version, permission, output, and fallback contracts. Missing CLIs must degrade as capability missing , not whole platform failure. Before a CLI is promoted to required, bundled, or globally installed status, record installation audit, security boundary, rollback, and validation commands.

The platform shall treat one of AI's core strengths as turning unstructured or semi structured data into structured records. When long chats, research material, documents, reviews, logs, notes, or screenshots become requirements, specs, tasks, evidence items, tables, JSON, or evaluation inputs, the output shall keep a target schema, source provenance, null/ambiguity handling, and validation notes. Before structured output is used as evidence or automation input, it shall pass schema validation and sample/source audit.

Work modes shall be enforceable execution contracts, not prompt only preferences. Non quick work modes, including standard , ship first , research , and governance , shall include mode selection record targets in evaluator input with the selection reason, overrides, and enforcement checks. When mode policy or evaluator targets change, check work modes shall validate drift between the registry and evaluator policy.

Agents shall assume they can miss required items. Non quick work shall leave an omission prevention coverage record that classifies user instructions, requirements, plan items, required artifacts, and acceptance checks as covered , deferred , not applicable , or missing , then include omission check targets in evaluator input. Required missing items, unsupported covered items, and rationale free deferred / not applicable items require rework before close out.

The platform shall treat memory leaks and runtime resource leaks as reliability risks. Work that touches long running agents, servers, browser automation, subprocesses, workers, queues, caches, streams, large data processing, file handles, network connections, timers, or subscriptions shall set resource risk occurred=true and include resource check targets in evaluator input, with resource risks, lifecycle cleanup paths, and measurement or accepted risk evidence. Required unresolved risks, unsupported mitigations, missing cleanup paths, and missing measurement evidence require rework before close out.

When one platform action launches several CLI processes or uses stdout/stderr/stdin pipes, fan out/fan in, or merge gates, the platform shall model it as a checkable process graph instead of a shell string. Each process node needs adapter, command, args, cwd, env allowlist, timeout, and output bound. Pipe edges, safety controls, resource controls, source provenance, plan evidence, verification, and rollback shall be recorded. Such work shall include cli pipeline occurred=true and cli pipeline targets in evaluation input, and missing required process, pipe, safety, resource, provenance, or verification evidence requires rework before close out.

When a CLI pipeline hands data off through files, temp files, directories, caches, logs, reports, or other artifacts, each artifact shall declare artifact id , kind, workspace relative path, producer/consumer, size bound, format, cleanup/retention policy, provenance, and validation. mode=file or mode=artifact pipe edges shall reference artifact id ; paths with absolute paths, drive prefixes, backslashes, ~ , or .. require rework.

의미 있는 변경은 커밋하고 즉시 origin/main 에 push해야 한다.
모든 새 사용자 지시는 웹 검색으로 시작하고 공개 검색 기록을 남겨야 한다.
사용자 요청은 의미 요약으로 저장하고, 요청 결과 추적표에서 산출물/평가/커밋과 연결해야 한다.
요구사항은 사용자 작업에서 도출하고, 검토/변경/기준선화한 뒤 구현과 평가의 기준으로 사용해야 한다.
의미 있는 작업은 작업 요약, 계획 기록, 평가 보고서, 상세 히스토리를 남겨야 한다.
작업 결과가 초기 지시와 요구사항에 맞는지 평가하고, gap은 재작업해야 한다.
AI가 세팅을 잊지 않도록 세션 시작 시 메모리 부트스트랩 anchor를 확인해야 한다.
코딩 작업은 Python first, 조사 first, 오픈소스 검토 first를 기본으로 해야 한다.
최종 산출물의 사실 주장은 근거 기반으로 검증하고, 지식 베이스는 틀릴 수 있다고 가정해야 한다.
병렬 작업과 진행 중인 에이전트는 한 곳에서 상태를 볼 수 있어야 한다.
프로젝트 전용 산출물은 해당 프로젝트에 두고, 공통 자산만 폴더로 승격해야 한다.
의미 있는 구현 작업은 spec driven 방식처럼 스펙, 계획, 작업 목록, 검증, traceability 산출물을 거쳐야 한다.
커스텀 스킬 생성/수정은 명시적인 원본, trigger 예시, 검증, 전진 테스트, 개선 backlog, 평가 target을 남겨야 한다.
소스 코드 작성 전에는 best fit 아키텍처와 reference architecture를 조사하고 최소 두 개의 구조 후보와 선택 근거를 기록해야 한다.
대기업 엔지니어링, 공식 연구소, architecture center, 고신뢰 독립 출처 목록은 일반 source taxonomy와 분리된 registry로 관리해야 한다.
중요한 원천값, 설정값, 주장, 리뷰 신호, 가정, 계획 제약은 출처와 접근일을 추적하고, 모든 중요한 계획 단계는 근거와 연결해야 한다.
웹 검색은 사람이 실제로 검색하듯 세계 기술 블로그, 한국 빅테크 기술 블로그, 인도 기술 소스, 논문 검색 원천, 한국 로컬 리뷰 채널을 폭넓게 사용해야 한다.
한국 사용자 리뷰나 로컬 판단이 필요한 조사에서는 Naver Map, Kakao Map, Naver Blog/Search, 공식 페이지를 우선 확인하고 후보 페이지 품질을 평가해야 한다.
작업 성격에 따라 quick , standard , ship first , research , governance 모드를 선택하고, 모드별로 필수 산출물과 지연 개선을 다르게 관리해야 한다.
코딩 조사는 기술 스택별 공식 문서/표준, 버전 제약, high signal 이슈/토론 출처와 커뮤니티 신호 해석을 기록해야 한다.
코딩 조사는 유지보수 가능한 언어/런타임 선택, 아키텍처 이론과 실무자 의견의 분리 비교, 폴더 구조 후보와 폴더 의미를 기록해야 한다.
속도가 문제되거나 작업이 독립 lane으로 나뉠 수 있으면 병렬 실행 전 의존성, touch paths, 충돌 제어, coordination target, merge/rollback 전략을 검증해야 한다.
여러 조사 lane을 병렬 실행할 때는 모든 조사 lane을 기다리는 merge gate를 두고, contradiction/accepted evidence를 합성한 뒤 downstream 구현을 release해야 한다.
플랫폼은 Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams 알림을 설정 파일로 켜고 끌 수 있어야 하며, 실제 토큰이나 웹훅 URL은 사용자가 환경변수로 주입해야 한다.
루트 폴더 구조는 등록된 프로젝트, 예약 운영 폴더, 로컬 전용 폴더, 생성 산출물로 분류되어야 하며, 구조 변경 후 deterministic audit를 통과해야 한다.
등록된 프로젝트의 durable top level folder는 프로젝트 등록부에 설명되어야 하며, generated output pattern은 .gitignore 와 함께 검증되어야 한다.
이 저장소의 AI assistant 운영 원칙은 Codex 전용으로 고정하지 않고 Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, 또는 사용자가 선호하는 도구에서도 사용할 수 있는 tool agnostic principle과 thin runtime adapter 구조로 관리해야 한다.

마케팅, 소비자 인사이트, 시장 규모, 브랜드/GTM, 책/이론, 설문, 정량 수치 근거 조사는 marketing evidence profile.json 을 사용해 책/학술, 설문 방법론, 공개 통계, 시장 리포트, 플랫폼 행동 데이터의 evidence lane을 분리하고, 모든 숫자 근거의 값/단위/base/지역/기간/모집단/방법론/표본/스폰서/비교 가능성을 기록해야 한다.

프로젝트 스펙이 애매하거나 현재 소스/테스트/산출물과 다를 경우, 구현 전에 비교 근거를 기록하고 update spec , update source , ask user , defer 중 하나로 분류해야 한다. ask user 이슈는 안정적인 질문 ID, 선택지, 답변 형식, 결정 영향을 포함한 clarification needed 알림으로 사용자에게 질문하고, 답변이 기록되기 전까지 해당 스펙이나 소스를 변경하지 않아야 한다.

docs/ 는 instructions , policies , operating models , governance 카테고리로 관리해야 하며, 새 문서가 루트에 흩어지거나 필수 문서가 누락되지 않도록 docs/registry.json 과 docs audit 로 root 허용 파일, category placement, 필수 문서, 한영 companion을 검증해야 한다.

전체 저장소 navigation과 health check는 ops/projects/root structure policy.json , ops/projects/registry.json , docs/registry.json 같은 source of truth를 사용해야 하며, root folder class/source와 핵심 감사/테스트를 한 곳에서 확인할 수 있어야 한다.
저장소 운영 CLI는 유지보수를 위해 사람용 출력과 자동화용 JSON 출력을 분리하고, 필요한 검사 범위만 실행할 수 있는 category filter를 제공해야 한다.
저장소 운영 도구의 소스가 커지면 단일 스크립트에 CLI, 도메인 모델, 체크 정의, 실행, 직렬화를 섞지 말고 책임별 모듈로 분리해야 하며 기존 명령 호환성은 보존해야 한다.
프로젝트, 도구, 스킬, 문서, 스펙, 히스토리, 설정, 소스 코드의 durable name은 네임스페이스별 규칙으로 관리하고, 변경 후 deterministic naming audit를 통과해야 한다.
플랫폼 컨셉과 운영 철학은 주기적으로 재검토하고, 인간 최종 권한, scoped autonomy, rollback 가능성, 보안/프라이버시, 운영 비용과 agentic debt가 철학과 메모리 부트스트랩에 반영되어야 한다.
플랫폼은 첫 진입점과 운영 모델 문서에서 목적, 해결하는 문제, 핵심 루프, 축적되는 자산, 프로젝트 경계, 근거 기반 평가 가치를 포함한 상세한 정체성 설명을 제공해야 한다.
새 코딩 프로젝트는 기술별 blueprint로 dry run 계획을 먼저 확인하고, 적용 시 root project 등록, 프로젝트별 README/docs/specs/configs/tests/tools/artifacts, 기술별 공식 문서 체크리스트, coding research 연결점을 자동 준비할 수 있어야 한다.
의미 있는 작업은 phase별 소요시간을 history/work timings/ 에 기록하고, coordination board, Workspace Monitor, 평가 입력에서 slowest phase와 병목 후보를 확인할 수 있어야 한다.
특정 상황에서 깊은 조사가 필요하면 deep research agent 가 다중 검색 채널, 반복 조사 단계, 출처 품질 평가, evidence item, contradiction mapping, citation audit, report outline, report target을 기록하고 긴 보고서 작성 준비 상태를 검증해야 한다.
웹 검색 품질이 중요한 작업은 사람이 실제로 검색하듯 query ladder, 검색 연산자, source lane, regional/community/contrary search, snowballing, selective summary capture를 사용하고, 좋은 출처는 재사용 가능할 때만 요약해야 한다.
사용자가 AI를 더 잘 쓰고 싶어 하거나 작업 중 AI 사용 간극이 보이면, 플랫폼은 이를 개인 탓이 아니라 작업 맥락, task fit, 반복, 검증, 도구화, 자산화 gap으로 진단하고 가장 작은 bridge intervention을 적용해야 한다.
사용자 지시가 모호하거나 편향적이거나 결론을 유도하거나 검증 가능한 출력 계약이 없거나 LLM을 결정론적 진실 기계로 가정하면, 실행 전에 목표, 맥락, 제약, 출력 형식, 성공 기준, 반대 근거, 검증 경로를 포함한 중립적 task brief로 재작성해야 한다.

모델 성능과 유형에 따라 프롬프팅 전략을 달리해야 한다. 약한/비추론/불확실 모델은 비용과 지연이 허용되고 작업 편차가 크면 두 번의 독립 시도 또는 초안 비평 수정 loop를 실행해 비교/병합하고, 추론/강한 모델은 불필요한 중복 호출보다 명확한 목표/맥락/제약/검증을 우선해야 한다. 반복 호출 결과는 사실 증명이 아니므로 출처, 테스트, 도구, evaluator 또는 인간 판단으로 검증해야 한다.

플랫폼의 최종 목적은 사람의 반복적인 작업을 계속 줄이고, 더 효율적인 방법을 만들며, 작업 시간을 줄이는 것이다. 이를 위해 에이전트는 인간이 실제로 수행하는 조사/판단/실행/검증 프로세스를 관찰해 재현 가능한 단계로 모델링하고, 자동화 가치가 있는 반복은 프롬프트, 워크플로, 템플릿, 도구, 스킬, 에이전트 또는 프로젝트 기능으로 승격해야 한다. 자동화는 인간 판단이 필요한 지점과 검증/rollback 경계를 보존해야 한다.

모호한 사용자 지시는 나쁜 결과의 주요 원인이므로 에이전트는 필요할 때 역질문으로 목적, 맥락, 제약, 출력 계약, 성공 기준을 구체화해야 한다. 단, 질문이 무한히 이어지지 않도록 clarification budget 을 적용해 보통 1회, 많아도 2회 이내로 묶고, 질문은 최대 3개까지 우선순위화해야 한다. 답변이 없거나 계속 모호하면 합리적 가정으로 진행, 선택지 기반 기본값 적용, 선작업 후 확인, 또는 명시적 보류 중 하나로 수렴해야 한다.

사용자 답변 대기나 clarification needed 가 발생해도 전체 작업을 멈추지 않아야 한다. 에이전트는 답변 없이는 결정할 수 없는 항목만 blocked decision 으로 격리하고, 영향받지 않는 조사, 출처 수집, 대안 비교, 초안 작성, 테스트, 검증, 문서화, 리스크 정리는 계속 진행해야 한다. 진행 중 사용한 가정, 기본값, 보류 항목, 답변 수신 후 병합/수정 방법은 unblocked work , assumptions , resume action 으로 기록해야 한다.

여러 blocked decision , clarification needed , 승인, 선호 결정은 흩어진 채팅이 아니라 중앙 human decision inbox에 모아야 한다. 각 항목은 안정적인 ID, 질문/선택지, 답변 형식, 의존 작업, 현재 진행 가능한 작업, 알림 이벤트, 답변 수신 후 interrupt policy , checkpoint required , resume action 을 포함해야 한다. 사람이 돌아와 답변하면 에이전트는 현재 작업을 안전하게 checkpoint하고, 우선순위와 위험도에 따라 해당 작업을 인터럽트해 재개하거나 다음 안전 지점에 예약한 뒤 inbox 상태를 갱신해야 한다.

플랫폼 설치는 work mode 와 별개의 install mode 로 관리해야 한다. user 설치는 플랫폼 사용, 산출물 보기, monitor 실행/배포처럼 사용자를 위한 최소 regular/runtime 경로를 제공하고, developer 설치는 플랫폼 개선, 소스 수정, 검증 harness 변경, 공통 규칙 변경을 위한 editable install, devDependencies, 테스트, governance check를 제공해야 한다. 설치 명령이 실제로 실행되어 dependency나 환경 상태가 바뀌면 기존 설치 감사 기록 규칙을 따라야 한다.

플랫폼을 사용자가 설치하는 desktop/end user software로 제품화할 때는 platform desktop app/ 별도 루트 프로젝트에서 관리해야 한다. end user installer packaging은 레포지토리 setup install mode 와 구분하고, Tauri/Electron/native packaging 후보 비교, OS별 installer format, signing/notarization, update, uninstall/rollback, secret/privacy, dependency/license review, installer smoke test release gate를 기록해야 한다.

플랫폼 컴포넌트의 언어/런타임은 Python, TypeScript/Next.js, Rust/Tauri, Go, Electron을 일괄 선호하지 말고 컴포넌트 경계와 측정 가능한 병목에 따라 선택해야 한다. 기본값은 Python for agent logic, TypeScript/Next.js for UI, Rust/Tauri for desktop shell/native command boundary, Go for local daemon/CLI, Electron as fallback이며, Rust/Go 전환 전에는 bottleneck metric, prototype measurement, release gate, rollback plan을 기록해야 한다.

런타임/언어 선택은 조사에서 끝나지 않고 설계로 이어져야 한다. Rust, Go, Tauri, Wails, Electron, Python, TypeScript/Next.js 같은 선택은 공식 문서, 아키텍처/ADR 참고, 오픈소스 구현, 이슈/토론 신호, 반대 사례를 조사하고, 최소 두 후보 설계, ADR style 결정 기록, prototype measurement plan, 설치 감사/rollback 계획을 남긴 뒤 구현 또는 의존성 설치로 넘어가야 한다.

플랫폼은 설치형으로 발전하더라도 특정 CLI, AI assistant CLI, package manager, deployment CLI, vendor shell에 종속되면 안 된다. 설치형 플랫폼은 workspace, history, docs, evaluation, settings, UI, orchestration layer를 제공하고, 외부 CLI는 availability/version/permission/output/fallback contract를 가진 교체 가능한 adapter로 붙여야 한다. CLI가 없으면 전체 플랫폼 실패가 아니라 capability missing 으로 degrade해야 하며, CLI를 required/bundled/global install 대상으로 승격하기 전에는 설치 감사, 보안 경계, rollback, 검증 명령을 기록해야 한다.

플랫폼은 AI의 핵심 강점 중 하나를 비정형 또는 반정형 데이터를 정형 기록으로 바꾸는 능력으로 취급해야 한다. 긴 대화, 조사 자료, 문서, 리뷰, 로그, 메모, 스크린샷을 요구사항, 스펙, 태스크, evidence item, 표, JSON, 평가 입력으로 바꿀 때는 target schema, source provenance, null/ambiguity handling, validation note를 함께 남겨야 하며, 정형화 결과를 근거나 자동화 입력으로 쓰기 전에는 schema validation과 sample/source audit를 거쳐야 한다.

작업 모드는 단순 프롬프트 선호가 아니라 강제 가능한 실행 계약이어야 한다. quick 이 아닌 standard , ship first , research , governance 작업은 모드 선택 이유, override, enforcement check를 기록한 mode selection record targets 를 평가 입력에 포함해야 하며, 모드 정책이나 evaluator target이 바뀌면 check work modes 가 registry와 evaluator drift를 검사해야 한다.

에이전트는 필수 항목을 빠뜨릴 수 있다고 가정해야 한다. quick 이 아닌 작업은 사용자 지시, 요구사항, 계획 항목, 필수 산출물, acceptance check를 covered , deferred , not applicable , missing 으로 분류한 누락 방지 coverage 기록을 남기고, omission check targets 를 평가 입력에 포함해야 한다. 필수 missing 항목, 근거 없는 covered , 이유 없는 deferred / not applicable 은 close out 전 재작업 대상이다.

플랫폼은 메모리 누수와 런타임 리소스 누수를 신뢰성 위험으로 다뤄야 한다. 장시간 실행 에이전트, 서버, 브라우저 자동화, subprocess, worker, queue, cache, stream, 대용량 처리, 파일 핸들, 네트워크 연결, timer, subscription을 건드리는 작업은 resource risk occurred=true 로 표시하고, 리소스 위험, 생명주기 cleanup path, 측정 또는 수용 근거를 기록한 resource check targets 를 평가 입력에 포함해야 한다. 필수 unresolved 위험, 근거 없는 mitigation, cleanup path 누락, 측정 근거 누락은 close out 전 재작업 대상이다.

플랫폼은 하나의 동작이 여러 CLI 프로세스를 실행하거나 stdout/stderr/stdin pipe, fan out/fan in, merge gate를 사용할 때 이를 shell string이 아니라 검증 가능한 process graph로 모델링해야 한다. 각 process node는 adapter, command, args, cwd, env allowlist, timeout, output bound를 가져야 하며, pipe edge, safety control, resource control, source provenance, plan evidence, verification, rollback을 기록해야 한다. 해당 작업은 cli pipeline occurred=true 와 cli pipeline targets 를 평가 입력에 포함해야 하며, 필수 process/pipe/safety/resource/provenance/verification 누락은 close out 전 재작업 대상이다.

CLI pipeline이 파일, 임시 파일, 디렉터리, cache, log, report, 기타 artifact로 handoff하면 각 artifact는 artifact id , kind, workspace relative path, producer/consumer, size bound, format, cleanup/retention policy, provenance, validation을 명시해야 한다. mode=file 또는 mode=artifact pipe는 artifact id 를 참조해야 하며, absolute path, drive prefix, backslash, ~ , .. 가 있는 경로는 재작업 대상이다.
The project shall be a Vercel deployable Next.js project.
The app shall let the user browse repository history, work summaries, request traces, projects, agent/task status, requirements, specs, and evaluations from one UI.
Markdown documents shall be viewable as readable HTML previews.
The app shall work locally while the repository is private and be deployable to Vercel after the repository is made public.
The structure shall be extensible, separating document parsing, UI components, data models, and deployment settings.
The project shall support pre publication review for sensitive data in generated snapshots.

The app shall collect work summaries, user requests, request traces, web searches, plans, evaluations, and daily history under history/ into a date indexed web UI that can be filtered by date and type.
The web UI should show root folder structure, docs categories, project top level homes, and history source roots so folder boundaries and data provenance are understandable.
The UI shall combine agent definitions from agent platform/configs/agents/ with coordination runtime state so users can visually see which agents exist.
The UI shall visualize history/ document density by date and distribution by history type.
Vercel에 배포 가능한 Next.js 프로젝트여야 한다.
저장소의 히스토리, 작업 요약, 요청 추적, 프로젝트, 에이전트/작업 상태, 요구사항, 스펙, 평가 문서를 한 화면에서 탐색할 수 있어야 한다.
Markdown 문서를 읽기 편한 HTML preview로 보여줄 수 있어야 한다.
현재 private repository에서도 로컬로 쓸 수 있고, 나중에 public 전환 후 Vercel에 올릴 수 있어야 한다.
확장 가능한 구조여야 하며 문서 파싱, UI 컴포넌트, 데이터 모델, 배포 설정이 분리되어야 한다.
public 배포 전 민감 정보가 snapshot에 들어가는지 검토할 수 있어야 한다.
history/ 의 작업 요약, 요청 요약, 요청 추적, 웹 검색, 계획, 평가, 일일 기록을 날짜별로 모아 웹 UI에서 날짜와 유형으로 탐색할 수 있어야 한다.
웹 UI는 루트 폴더 구조, docs 카테고리, 프로젝트별 top level home, 히스토리 수집 위치를 보여줘 폴더 경계와 데이터 출처를 이해할 수 있어야 한다.
웹 UI는 agent platform/configs/agents/ 의 에이전트 정의와 coordination runtime 상태를 합쳐 어떤 에이전트가 있는지 시각적으로 보여줘야 한다.
웹 UI는 history/ 문서의 날짜별 밀도와 유형별 분포를 시각화해야 한다.

documents.html:
Work Evaluation: CLI Pipeline File/Artifact Handoff

Conclusion

  • Status: ready_to_close
  • Work mode: governance
  • Result: the initial request was addressed and no blocking gap remains.

Completed Work

  • Added REQ-WS-059 so CLI pipeline file/temp artifact/cache/log/report handoffs are managed as explicit artifact contracts.
  • check-cli-pipeline now validates artifacts and artifact_id.
  • Artifact paths must be workspace-relative and reject absolute paths, drive prefixes, backslashes, ~, and ...
  • Temp/cache artifacts require cleanup_policy; output/log/report/directory artifacts require retention_policy.
  • Updated workflow, prompt, persistent instructions, memory bootstrap, CLI adapter registry, README, docs, and history.

Verification

  • python3 -m unittest discover -s tests: 142 tests OK
  • check-cli-pipeline configs/integrations/cli-pipeline-template.json: pipeline_ready
  • check-work-modes: ready
  • check-memory-bootstrap: ready_to_bootstrap
  • core check-config-contract: self_documenting
  • check-omissions: coverage_ready
  • check-resources: resource_ready
  • check-grounding: ready_to_publish
  • docs-audit: docs_ready
  • naming-audit: clean
  • structure-audit: clean with existing presentation-agent generated-output warnings
  • workspace-index, task-board, and workspace-monitor collect completed

Limits And Follow-Ups

  • An actual file-producing multi-process runner is outside this change.
  • A future runner should measure file handle lifecycle, temp-file cleanup, artifact size growth, and stream backpressure.
  • Existing structure warnings remain for presentation-agent/playwright-report and presentation-agent/test-results.

Evidence Files

  • Evaluation input: _history/evaluations/2026/2026-06-02-cli-pipeline-file-artifact-handoffs-evaluation-input.json

결론

  • 상태: ready_to_close
  • 작업 모드: governance
  • 평가 결과: 초기 요청을 반영했고 blocking gap은 없다.

완료 내용

  • REQ-WS-059를 추가해 CLI pipeline의 file/temp artifact/cache/log/report handoff를 명시적 artifact 계약으로 관리하게 했다.
  • check-cli-pipeline이 artifacts와 artifact_id를 검증한다.
  • artifact path는 workspace-relative여야 하며 absolute path, drive prefix, backslash, ~, ..를 거부한다.
  • temp/cache는 cleanup_policy, output/log/report/directory는 retention_policy를 요구한다.
  • workflow, prompt, persistent instructions, memory bootstrap, CLI adapter registry, README, docs, history를 갱신했다.

  • 실제 file-producing multi-process runner는 이번 작업의 범위가 아니다.
  • runner 구현 시 file handle lifecycle, temp-file cleanup, artifact size growth, stream backpressure를 실제 측정해야 한다.

documents.html:
2026-06-02 작업 로그

비차단 역질문 규칙

  • 사용자 요청: 질문에 답하지 않으면 AI가 전체 작업을 멈추는 문제가 큰 병목이라고 지적했다.
  • 처리:
  • 웹 검색으로 HITL, blocked dependency, non-blocking workflow 근거를 확인했다.
  • REQ-WS-047을 요구사항 기준선에 추가했다.
  • agent-platform/configs/usage/ai-usage-gap-profile.json에 global_pause_on_clarification, non_blocking_progress, non_blocking_clarification_policy를 추가했다.
  • 운영 모델, workflow, prompt, persistent instructions, AGENTS, memory bootstrap, spec/source reconciliation 문서를 갱신했다.
  • 히스토리, 조사 노트, 스펙, 평가 입력, 타이밍 기록을 작성했다.
  • 관련 기록:
  • _history/web-searches/2026/2026-06-02-non-blocking-clarification.ko.md
  • _history/plans/2026/2026-06-02-non-blocking-clarification.ko.md
  • _history/request-traces/2026/2026-06-02-non-blocking-clarification.ko.md
  • _history/evaluations/2026/2026-06-02-non-blocking-clarification.ko.md

Human Decision Inbox와 인터럽트 재개

  • 사용자 요청: 답변이 필요한 문제를 한 번에 모으고, 사람이 돌아오면 해당 답변을 반영해 interrupt/resume하며, 답변 전까지 다른 작업을 계속하는 구조를 요청했다.
  • 처리:
  • 웹 검색으로 LangChain HITL, Microsoft Agent Framework AG-UI, Conductor Human Task, GitHub issue dependency 근거를 확인했다.
  • REQ-WS-048을 요구사항 기준선에 추가했다.
  • _ops/coordination/human-decision-inbox.json을 중앙 인박스로 추가했다.
  • _ops/workflows/61-human-decision-inbox.md와 _ops/prompts/91-human-decision-inbox.md를 추가했다.
  • AI usage gap profile, notification config, persistent instructions, AGENTS.md, memory bootstrap, router, index에 inbox 및 checkpointed interrupt/resume 규칙을 연결했다.
  • 히스토리, 조사 노트, 스펙, 평가 입력, 타이밍 기록을 작성했다.
  • 관련 기록:
  • _history/web-searches/2026/2026-06-02-human-decision-inbox.ko.md
  • _history/plans/2026/2026-06-02-human-decision-inbox.ko.md
  • _history/request-traces/2026/2026-06-02-human-decision-inbox.ko.md
  • _history/evaluations/2026/2026-06-02-human-decision-inbox.ko.md

설치 모드 분리

  • 사용자 요청: 플랫폼 사용 모드와 개선 모드에 맞춰 사용자용 설치와 개발자용 설치를 따로 구현하라고 요청했다.
  • 처리:
  • 웹 검색으로 pip regular/editable install, Python pyproject dependency 구조, npm dev dependency omit, Vercel Next.js 배포 근거를 확인했다.
  • REQ-WS-049를 요구사항 기준선에 추가했다.
  • agent-platform/configs/installations/install-mode-registry.json에 user와 developer 설치 프로필을 추가했다.
  • agent-platform CLI에 check-install-modes, list-install-modes, show-install-mode를 추가했다.
  • 설치 모드 정책, workflow, prompt, README, persistent instructions, memory bootstrap, router, index를 갱신했다.
  • 실제 dependency 설치는 실행하지 않았다.
  • 관련 기록:
  • _history/web-searches/2026/2026-06-02-install-mode-split.ko.md
  • _history/plans/2026/2026-06-02-install-mode-split.ko.md
  • _history/request-traces/2026/2026-06-02-install-mode-split.ko.md
  • _history/evaluations/2026/2026-06-02-install-mode-split.ko.md

설치형 소프트웨어 제품화

  • 사용자 요청: 플랫폼을 Visual Studio 같은 설치형 소프트웨어 구조로 만들고 싶다고 했다.
  • 처리:
  • 웹 검색으로 Electron, Tauri, Microsoft MSIX, Apple notarization 공식 문서를 확인했다.
  • REQ-WS-050을 요구사항 기준선에 추가했다.
  • platform-desktop-app/를 새 루트 프로젝트로 만들고 _ops/projects/registry.json에 등록했다.
  • platform-desktop-app/configs/desktop-distribution-registry.json에 Tauri/Electron/native packaging 후보, OS별 packaging targets, release gates, runtime strategy, secret/privacy rules를 정리했다.
  • 설치형 소프트웨어 정책, workflow, prompt, persistent instructions, memory bootstrap, router, index를 갱신했다.
  • 실제 Tauri/Electron dependency 설치는 하지 않았다.
  • 관련 기록:
  • _history/web-searches/2026/2026-06-02-installable-software-productization.ko.md

  • _history/evaluations/2026/2026-06-02-installable-software-productization.ko.md

에이전트와 히스토리 시각화

  • 사용자 요청: 에이전트들이 무엇이 있는지 시각화하고 히스토리도 시각화해 달라고 했다.

  • workspace-monitor Overview/Agents/History 화면에 에이전트 런타임 분포, 인벤토리, task lane, 날짜별 히스토리 밀도, 문서 유형별 막대를 추가했다.
  • 관련 스펙, 요청 추적, 평가 입력, 타이밍 기록을 작성했다.
  • 관련 기록:
  • _history/web-searches/2026/2026-06-02-agent-history-visualization.ko.md
  • _history/plans/2026/2026-06-02-agent-history-visualization.ko.md
  • _history/request-traces/2026/2026-06-02-agent-history-visualization.ko.md

  • 사용자 요청: 플랫폼과 설치형 소프트웨어를 만들 때 Rust, Go 같은 효율적인 소프트웨어 언어 중 좋은 방향을 찾아 달라고 했다.
  • 처리:
  • 웹 검색으로 Rust, Go, Tauri, Wails, Electron, Python 공식 자료를 확인했다.
  • REQ-WS-051을 요구사항 기준선에 추가했다.
  • agent-platform/configs/runtime/language-decision-registry.json을 추가해 컴포넌트 경계별 언어 기본값과 decision gate를 정리했다.
  • _docs/policies/runtime-language-selection-policy.*.md를 추가했다.
  • platform-desktop-app packaging strategy와 desktop distribution registry에 Go local service/Wails 비교 후보를 추가했다.
  • memory bootstrap에 language decision registry와 runtime language policy를 warm anchor로 연결했다.

documents.html:
2026-06-02 Work Summary

Non-Blocking Clarification

  • Request: The user pointed out that AI stopping every task while waiting for one answer is a major bottleneck.
  • Result: Added REQ-WS-047 and updated platform rules so pending answers isolate only blocked_decision items while safe independent work continues as unblocked_work.
  • Core rule: Do not pause the whole task. Pause only what cannot be decided without the answer, and record assumptions plus resume_action for later correction.
  • Related spec: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-non-blocking-clarification/
  • Web search record: _history/web-searches/2026/2026-06-02-non-blocking-clarification.en.md
  • Timing record: _history/work-timings/2026/2026-06-02-non-blocking-clarification.json
  • Commit: 60e458e pushed

Human Decision Inbox

  • Request: The user asked for a structure that collects human-needed issues at once, interrupts/resumes when the human returns, and keeps other work moving while waiting.
  • Result: Added REQ-WS-048 and created _ops/coordination/human-decision-inbox.json as the central inbox.
  • Core rule: Questions become inbox records instead of loose chat. While waiting, unblocked_work continues. When an answer arrives, current work is checkpointed first, then the agent chooses immediate resume or next-safe-point resume by priority and risk.
  • Related workflow: _ops/workflows/61-human-decision-inbox.md
  • Related prompt: _ops/prompts/91-human-decision-inbox.md
  • Related spec: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-human-decision-inbox/
  • Web search record: _history/web-searches/2026/2026-06-02-human-decision-inbox.en.md
  • Timing record: _history/work-timings/2026/2026-06-02-human-decision-inbox.json

Install Mode Split

  • Request: The user asked for separate user and developer installation paths matching platform use mode and improvement mode.
  • Result: Added REQ-WS-049 and created user/developer install profiles in agent-platform/configs/installations/install-mode-registry.json.
  • Core rule: install_mode controls environment setup scope, while work_mode controls task evaluation strictness. User install favors regular/runtime paths; developer install favors editable installs, devDependencies, tests, and governance checks.
  • CLI: check-install-modes, list-install-modes, show-install-mode
  • Related spec: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-install-mode-split/
  • Web search record: _history/web-searches/2026/2026-06-02-install-mode-split.en.md
  • Timing record: _history/work-timings/2026/2026-06-02-install-mode-split.json

Installable Software Productization

  • Request: The user said they want to make the platform installable software, similar to Visual Studio-style software.
  • Result: Added REQ-WS-050 and created the new root project platform-desktop-app/.
  • Core rule: end-user installer packaging is separate from repository setup install_mode. Desktop app productization needs Tauri/Electron/native packaging comparison, OS installer formats, signing/notarization, update/uninstall/rollback, privacy/security/license review, and smoke-test release gates.
  • Current recommendation: Tauri-first prototype. The final decision waits until native API, updater, and Python sidecar/local service needs are clearer.
  • Actual installation: none.
  • Related spec: platform-desktop-app/specs/2026-06-02-installable-desktop/
  • Web search record: _history/web-searches/2026/2026-06-02-installable-software-productization.en.md
  • Timing record: _history/work-timings/2026/2026-06-02-installable-software-productization.json

Agent And History Visualization

  • Request: The user asked to visualize which agents exist and visualize the work history.
  • Result: Added agentCatalog to the workspace-monitor snapshot so agent definitions from agent-platform/configs/agents/, coordination runtime state, task counts, and documentation links can be inspected in one place.
  • UI: Overview now shows agent runtime distribution and history density, Agents shows inventory/status/task lanes, and History shows date density plus document category bars.
  • Related spec: workspace-monitor/specs/2026-06-02-agent-history-visualization/
  • Web search record: _history/web-searches/2026/2026-06-02-agent-history-visualization.en.md
  • Timing record: _history/work-timings/2026/2026-06-02-agent-history-visualization.json

Runtime Language Direction

  • Request: The user asked to find a good direction for efficient languages such as Rust and Go for the platform and installable software.
  • Result: Added REQ-WS-051 and created a language decision registry defining the roles of Python, TypeScript/Next.js, Rust/Tauri, Go, and Electron by component boundary.
  • Core direction: Python for agent logic, TypeScript/Next.js for UI, Rust/Tauri for desktop shell/native boundaries, Go for local daemons/CLIs, and Electron as fallback.
  • Related policy: _docs/policies/runtime-language-selection-policy.en.md
  • Related spec: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-runtime-language-direction/
  • Web search record: _history/web-searches/2026/2026-06-02-runtime-language-direction.en.md
  • Timing record: _history/work-timings/2026/2026-06-02-runtime-language-direction.json

Runtime Research/Design

  • Request: The user said runtime/language choices should include research and that this process should be designed.
  • Result: Added REQ-WS-052 and extended the language decision registry with research/design process, decision record contract, and prototype design contract.
  • Core structure: research official docs, ADR/architecture references, open-source implementations, issue/discussion signals, and contrary cases; then move into candidate design, ADR-style decision record, and prototype measurement plan.
  • Related workflow/prompt: _ops/workflows/64-runtime-language-research-design.md, _ops/prompts/94-runtime-language-research-design.md
  • Related template: _templates/runtime-language-decision/runtime-language-decision.en.md
  • Related spec: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-runtime-research-design/

CLI Adapter Boundary

  • Request: The user said the platform is installable but can use many CLIs and should not depend on any specific CLI.
  • Result: Added REQ-WS-053 and created agent-platform/configs/integrations/cli-adapter-registry.json to define external CLIs as optional adapter capabilities.
  • Core structure: The platform provides workspace/history/docs/evaluation/UI/orchestration; CLIs attach only through adapters with availability, version, permission, output, and fallback contracts.
  • Policy: _docs/policies/cli-adapter-policy.en.md
  • Workflow/prompt: _ops/workflows/66-cli-adapter-integration.md, _ops/prompts/97-cli-adapter-integration.md
  • Spec: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-cli-adapter-boundary/

Unstructured Data Structuring

  • Request: The user said that one thing AI does well is structuring unstructured data.
  • Result: Added REQ-WS-054 and agent-platform/configs/usage/unstructured-data-structuring-profile.json to define a structuring capability with schema, provenance, null/ambiguity handling, and validation.
  • Core structure: Long chats, documents, research material, reviews, logs, and notes can become requirements, specs, tasks, evidence items, tables, JSON, and evaluation inputs while keeping source location and validation results.
  • Policy: _docs/policies/unstructured-data-structuring-policy.en.md
  • Workflow/prompt: _ops/workflows/67-structure-unstructured-data.md, _ops/prompts/98-structure-unstructured-data.md
  • Spec: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-unstructured-data-structuring/

Work Mode Enforcement

  • Request: The user said prompt-only work modes are not enforced and the platform design needs enforced modes.
  • Result: Added REQ-WS-055 and added mode_enforcement, mode-level enforcement fields, and mode_selection_record_targets to work-mode-registry.json.
  • Implementation: Added agent-platform/src/agent_platform/work_modes.py plus check-work-modes, list-work-modes, and show-work-mode CLI commands.
  • Evaluation: work_evaluator.py now treats missing mode selection records as blocking for non-quick modes.
  • Policy: _docs/policies/work-mode-enforcement-policy.en.md
  • Workflows: _ops/workflows/02-select-work-mode.md, _ops/workflows/40-evaluate-and-rework.md
  • Spec: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-work-mode-enforcement/

Omission Prevention Gate

  • Request: The user noted that an agent can miss something during work.
  • Result: Added REQ-WS-056, omission-guard-agent, and the check-omissions CLI command.
  • Core structure: non-quick work includes omission_check_targets in evaluator input. Required items are classified as covered, deferred, not_applicable, or missing; covered needs evidence and deferred/not_applicable need rationale.
  • Implementation: agent-platform/src/agent_platform/evaluation/omission_guard.py, agent-platform/src/agent_platform/evaluation/work_evaluator.py, agent-platform/src/agent_platform/cli.py
  • Policy/workflow: _docs/policies/omission-prevention-policy.en.md, _ops/workflows/68-omission-prevention.md, _ops/prompts/99-omission-prevention.md
  • Spec: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-omission-prevention/
  • Web search record: _history/web-searches/2026/2026-06-02-omission-prevention.en.md
  • Timing record: _history/work-timings/2026/2026-06-02-omission-prevention.json

Resource Leak Prevention Gate

  • Request: The user noted that this kind of platform must be careful about memory leaks.
  • Result: Added REQ-WS-057, resource-guard-agent, and the check-resources CLI command.
  • Core structure: work with long-running runtimes, browser automation, workers, caches, streams, large-data processing, external CLIs, or similar resource risk includes resource_risk_occurred=true and resource_check_targets in evaluator input.
  • Implementation: agent-platform/src/agent_platform/evaluation/resource_guard.py, agent-platform/src/agent_platform/evaluation/work_evaluator.py, agent-platform/src/agent_platform/cli.py
  • Policy/workflow: _docs/policies/resource-leak-prevention-policy.en.md, _ops/workflows/69-resource-leak-prevention.md, _ops/prompts/100-resource-leak-prevention.md
  • Spec: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-resource-leak-prevention/
  • Web search record: _history/web-searches/2026/2026-06-02-resource-leak-prevention.en.md
  • Timing record: _history/work-timings/2026/2026-06-02-resource-leak-prevention.json

CLI Pipeline Orchestration

  • Request: The user asked for one CLI action to run several internal processes and orchestrate multiple CLIs through pipes or similar mechanisms.
  • Result: Added REQ-WS-058, cli-pipeline-agent, and the check-cli-pipeline CLI command.
  • Core structure: multiple CLIs are represented as a process graph instead of a shell string. Each CLI is a process node, stdout/stderr/stdin links are pipe edges, and result fan-in is a merge strategy.
  • Implementation: agent-platform/src/agent_platform/integrations/cli_pipeline.py, agent-platform/src/agent_platform/cli.py, agent-platform/src/agent_platform/evaluation/work_evaluator.py
  • Config/docs: agent-platform/configs/integrations/cli-pipeline-template.json, agent-platform/configs/agents/cli-pipeline-agent.json, agent-platform/docs/cli-pipeline-agent.en.md
  • Policy/workflow: _docs/policies/cli-adapter-policy.en.md, _ops/workflows/71-cli-pipeline-orchestration.md, _ops/prompts/101-cli-pipeline-orchestration.md
  • Spec: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-cli-pipeline-orchestration/

  • Timing record: _history/work-timings/2026/2026-06-02-cli-pipeline-orchestration.json

CLI Pipeline File/Artifact Handoff

  • Request: The user asked to include files and other handoff methods after the prior CLI pipe structure.
  • Result: Added REQ-WS-059 and extended cli-pipeline-agent to validate artifacts.
  • Core structure: mode=file or mode=artifact pipe edges reference artifact_id. Artifacts need workspace-relative path, producer/consumer, max_bytes, format, cleanup/retention, provenance, and validation.
  • Security/operations rule: paths with absolute paths, drive prefixes, backslashes, ~, or .. require rework. Temp/cache artifacts need cleanup policy; output/log/report/directory artifacts need retention policy.

비차단 역질문

  • 요청: 질문에 답하지 않으면 AI가 모든 작업을 멈추는 단점이 큰 병목이라고 지적했다.
  • 처리: REQ-WS-047을 추가하고, 답변 대기 항목을 blocked_decision으로 격리하며 안전한 독립 작업은 unblocked_work로 계속 진행하도록 플랫폼 규칙을 갱신했다.
  • 핵심 규칙: 전체 작업을 멈추지 말고, 답변 없이는 결정할 수 없는 항목만 멈춘다. 진행 중 사용한 가정과 답변 후 수정 경로는 resume_action으로 남긴다.

  • 시간 기록: _history/work-timings/2026/2026-06-02-non-blocking-clarification.json
  • 커밋: 60e458e pushed

Human Decision Inbox

  • 요청: 답변이 필요한 문제들을 한 번에 모으고, 사람이 돌아오면 interrupt/resume 하며, 그 전까지 다른 작업을 계속하는 구조를 요청했다.
  • 처리: REQ-WS-048을 추가하고 _ops/coordination/human-decision-inbox.json을 중앙 인박스로 만들었다.
  • 핵심 규칙: 질문은 loose chat이 아니라 inbox record로 남기고, 답변 대기 중에는 unblocked_work를 계속하며, 답변 수신 시 현재 작업을 checkpoint한 뒤 우선순위/위험도에 따라 즉시 재개 또는 다음 안전 지점 재개를 선택한다.
  • 관련 workflow: _ops/workflows/61-human-decision-inbox.md
  • 관련 prompt: _ops/prompts/91-human-decision-inbox.md
  • 관련 스펙: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-human-decision-inbox/
  • 관련 웹 검색 기록: _history/web-searches/2026/2026-06-02-human-decision-inbox.ko.md
  • 시간 기록: _history/work-timings/2026/2026-06-02-human-decision-inbox.json

설치 모드 분리

  • 요청: 플랫폼 사용 모드와 개선 모드에 맞춰 사용자용 설치와 개발자용 설치를 따로 구현해달라고 요청했다.
  • 처리: REQ-WS-049를 추가하고 agent-platform/configs/installations/install-mode-registry.json에 user/developer 설치 프로필을 만들었다.
  • 핵심 규칙: install_mode는 환경 준비 범위이고 work_mode는 작업 평가 강도다. 사용자는 regular/runtime 중심, 개발자는 editable/devDependencies/tests/governance checks 중심으로 설치한다.
  • CLI: check-install-modes, list-install-modes, show-install-mode
  • 관련 스펙: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-install-mode-split/
  • 관련 웹 검색 기록: _history/web-searches/2026/2026-06-02-install-mode-split.ko.md
  • 시간 기록: _history/work-timings/2026/2026-06-02-install-mode-split.json

설치형 소프트웨어 제품화

  • 요청: 플랫폼을 Visual Studio 같은 설치형 소프트웨어 구조로 만들고 싶다고 했다.
  • 처리: REQ-WS-050을 추가하고 platform-desktop-app/를 새 루트 프로젝트로 만들었다.
  • 핵심 규칙: end-user installer packaging은 레포지토리 setup install_mode와 다르다. desktop app 제품화는 Tauri/Electron/native packaging 후보 비교, OS별 installer format, signing/notarization, update/uninstall/rollback, privacy/security/license review, smoke test release gate를 가져야 한다.
  • 현재 추천: Tauri-first prototype. 단, final decision은 native API, updater, Python sidecar/local service 요구가 명확해진 뒤 결정한다.
  • 실제 설치: 없음.
  • 관련 스펙: platform-desktop-app/specs/2026-06-02-installable-desktop/
  • 관련 웹 검색 기록: _history/web-searches/2026/2026-06-02-installable-software-productization.ko.md
  • 시간 기록: _history/work-timings/2026/2026-06-02-installable-software-productization.json

에이전트와 히스토리 시각화

  • 요청: 현재 플랫폼에 어떤 에이전트들이 있는지와 작업 히스토리를 시각화해 달라고 했다.
  • 처리: workspace-monitor snapshot에 agentCatalog를 추가하고 agent-platform/configs/agents/의 에이전트 정의, coordination runtime 상태, task 수, 문서 링크를 한 화면에서 볼 수 있게 했다.
  • UI: Overview에는 에이전트 런타임 분포와 히스토리 밀도를, Agents에는 인벤토리/상태/태스크 lane을, History에는 날짜별 밀도와 문서 유형별 막대를 추가했다.
  • 관련 스펙: workspace-monitor/specs/2026-06-02-agent-history-visualization/
  • 관련 웹 검색 기록: _history/web-searches/2026/2026-06-02-agent-history-visualization.ko.md
  • 시간 기록: _history/work-timings/2026/2026-06-02-agent-history-visualization.json

런타임/언어 방향

  • 요청: Rust, Go 같은 효율적인 언어 중 플랫폼과 설치형 소프트웨어에 맞는 좋은 방향을 찾아 달라고 했다.
  • 처리: REQ-WS-051을 추가하고 language decision registry를 만들어 Python, TypeScript/Next.js, Rust/Tauri, Go, Electron의 역할을 컴포넌트 경계별로 정리했다.
  • 핵심 방향: Python은 agent logic, TypeScript/Next.js는 UI, Rust/Tauri는 desktop shell/native boundary, Go는 local daemon/CLI, Electron은 fallback으로 둔다.
  • 관련 정책: _docs/policies/runtime-language-selection-policy.ko.md
  • 관련 스펙: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-runtime-language-direction/
  • 관련 웹 검색 기록: _history/web-searches/2026/2026-06-02-runtime-language-direction.ko.md
  • 시간 기록: _history/work-timings/2026/2026-06-02-runtime-language-direction.json

런타임 조사/설계

  • 요청: 런타임/언어 선택도 당연히 조사하고, 그런 과정을 설계해야 한다고 했다.
  • 처리: REQ-WS-052를 추가하고 language decision registry에 research/design process, decision record contract, prototype design contract를 추가했다.
  • 핵심 구조: 공식 문서와 ADR/architecture 참고, 오픈소스 구현, 이슈/토론 신호, 반대 사례를 조사한 뒤 후보 설계, ADR-style 결정 기록, prototype measurement plan으로 이어간다.
  • 관련 workflow/prompt: _ops/workflows/64-runtime-language-research-design.md, _ops/prompts/94-runtime-language-research-design.md
  • 관련 template: _templates/runtime-language-decision/runtime-language-decision.ko.md
  • 관련 스펙: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-runtime-research-design/

CLI 어댑터 경계

  • 요청: 플랫폼은 설치형이지만 다양한 CLI를 사용할 수 있고, 특정 CLI에 종속되지 않아야 한다고 했다.
  • 처리: REQ-WS-053을 추가하고 agent-platform/configs/integrations/cli-adapter-registry.json으로 외부 CLI를 optional adapter capability로 붙이는 경계를 정의했다.
  • 핵심 구조: 플랫폼은 workspace/history/docs/evaluation/UI/orchestration layer를 제공하고 CLI는 availability/version/permission/output/fallback contract를 가진 adapter로만 붙는다.
  • 관련 정책: _docs/policies/cli-adapter-policy.ko.md
  • 관련 workflow/prompt: _ops/workflows/66-cli-adapter-integration.md, _ops/prompts/97-cli-adapter-integration.md
  • 관련 스펙: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-cli-adapter-boundary/

비정형 데이터 정형화

  • 요청: AI가 잘하는 것 중 하나는 비정형 데이터를 정형화하는 것이라고 했다.
  • 처리: REQ-WS-054를 추가하고 agent-platform/configs/usage/unstructured-data-structuring-profile.json으로 schema, provenance, null/ambiguity handling, validation을 갖춘 정형화 capability를 정의했다.
  • 핵심 구조: 긴 대화, 문서, 조사 자료, 리뷰, 로그, 메모를 요구사항, 스펙, 태스크, evidence item, 표, JSON, 평가 입력으로 바꾸되, 근거 위치와 검증 결과를 함께 남긴다.
  • 관련 정책: _docs/policies/unstructured-data-structuring-policy.ko.md
  • 관련 workflow/prompt: _ops/workflows/67-structure-unstructured-data.md, _ops/prompts/98-structure-unstructured-data.md
  • 관련 스펙: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-unstructured-data-structuring/

작업 모드 강제화

  • 요청: 작업 모드를 프롬프트로만 시키면 강제되지 않으므로 설계를 탄탄하게 하려면 강제화해야 한다고 했다.
  • 처리: REQ-WS-055를 추가하고 work-mode-registry.json에 mode_enforcement, mode-level enforcement fields, mode_selection_record_targets를 추가했다.
  • 구현: agent-platform/src/agent_platform/work_modes.py와 check-work-modes, list-work-modes, show-work-mode CLI를 추가했다.
  • 평가: work_evaluator.py가 non-quick 모드의 mode selection record 누락을 blocking gap으로 처리한다.
  • 관련 정책: _docs/policies/work-mode-enforcement-policy.ko.md
  • 관련 workflow: _ops/workflows/02-select-work-mode.md, _ops/workflows/40-evaluate-and-rework.md
  • 관련 스펙: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-work-mode-enforcement/

누락 방지 게이트

  • 요청: 에이전트가 작업 중 무엇인가를 빼먹을 수 있다고 지적했다.
  • 처리: REQ-WS-056을 추가하고 omission-guard-agent와 check-omissions CLI를 만들었다.
  • 핵심 구조: non-quick 작업은 omission_check_targets를 평가 입력에 포함한다. 필수 항목은 covered, deferred, not_applicable, missing으로 분류하고, covered에는 근거, deferred/not_applicable에는 이유가 있어야 한다.
  • 구현: agent-platform/src/agent_platform/evaluation/omission_guard.py, agent-platform/src/agent_platform/evaluation/work_evaluator.py, agent-platform/src/agent_platform/cli.py
  • 관련 정책/workflow: _docs/policies/omission-prevention-policy.ko.md, _ops/workflows/68-omission-prevention.md, _ops/prompts/99-omission-prevention.md
  • 관련 스펙: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-omission-prevention/
  • 관련 웹 검색 기록: _history/web-searches/2026/2026-06-02-omission-prevention.ko.md
  • 시간 기록: _history/work-timings/2026/2026-06-02-omission-prevention.json

리소스 누수 방지 게이트

  • 요청: 이런 플랫폼은 메모리 누수에 주의해야 한다고 지적했다.
  • 처리: REQ-WS-057을 추가하고 resource-guard-agent와 check-resources CLI를 만들었다.
  • 핵심 구조: 장시간 실행, 브라우저 자동화, worker, cache, stream, 대용량 처리, 외부 CLI 등 리소스 위험이 있는 작업은 resource_risk_occurred=true와 resource_check_targets를 평가 입력에 포함한다.
  • 구현: agent-platform/src/agent_platform/evaluation/resource_guard.py, agent-platform/src/agent_platform/evaluation/work_evaluator.py, agent-platform/src/agent_platform/cli.py
  • 관련 정책/workflow: _docs/policies/resource-leak-prevention-policy.ko.md, _ops/workflows/69-resource-leak-prevention.md, _ops/prompts/100-resource-leak-prevention.md
  • 관련 스펙: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-resource-leak-prevention/
  • 관련 웹 검색 기록: _history/web-searches/2026/2026-06-02-resource-leak-prevention.ko.md
  • 시간 기록: _history/work-timings/2026/2026-06-02-resource-leak-prevention.json

CLI Pipeline Orchestration

  • 요청: CLI를 한 번 실행하면 내부에서 여러 프로세스가 돌고, pipe 등을 이용해 여러 CLI를 실행하는 구조를 만들라고 했다.
  • 처리: REQ-WS-058을 추가하고 cli-pipeline-agent와 check-cli-pipeline CLI를 만들었다.
  • 핵심 구조: 여러 CLI를 shell string이 아니라 process graph로 표현한다. 각 CLI는 process node, stdout/stderr/stdin 연결은 pipe edge, 결과 합류는 merge strategy로 남긴다.
  • 구현: agent-platform/src/agent_platform/integrations/cli_pipeline.py, agent-platform/src/agent_platform/cli.py, agent-platform/src/agent_platform/evaluation/work_evaluator.py
  • 설정/문서: agent-platform/configs/integrations/cli-pipeline-template.json, agent-platform/configs/agents/cli-pipeline-agent.json, agent-platform/docs/cli-pipeline-agent.ko.md
  • 관련 정책/workflow: _docs/policies/cli-adapter-policy.ko.md, _ops/workflows/71-cli-pipeline-orchestration.md, _ops/prompts/101-cli-pipeline-orchestration.md
  • 관련 스펙: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-cli-pipeline-orchestration/
  • 관련 웹 검색 기록: _history/web-searches/2026/2026-06-02-cli-pipeline-orchestration.ko.md
  • 시간 기록: _history/work-timings/2026/2026-06-02-cli-pipeline-orchestration.json

CLI Pipeline 파일/아티팩트 Handoff

  • 요청: 이전 CLI pipe 구조에 이어 파일과 기타 handoff 방식도 포함해 달라고 했다.
  • 처리: REQ-WS-059를 추가하고 cli-pipeline-agent가 artifacts 계약을 검증하게 했다.
  • 핵심 구조: mode=file 또는 mode=artifact pipe는 artifact_id를 참조한다. artifact는 workspace-relative path, producer/consumer, max_bytes, format, cleanup/retention, provenance, validation을 가져야 한다.
  • 보안/운영 규칙: absolute path, drive prefix, backslash, ~, ..가 있는 path는 재작업 대상이다. temp/cache는 cleanup policy, output/log/report/directory는 retention policy가 필요하다.
  • 관련 스펙: _specs/workspace-platform/2026-06-02-cli-pipeline-file-artifact-handoffs/

  • 시간 기록: _history/work-timings/2026/2026-06-02-cli-pipeline-file-artifact-handoffs.json

documents.html:
CLI Pipeline File/Artifact Handoff Web Search Record

Search Time

  • Date: 2026-06-02
  • Work mode: governance

Queries

  • Python tempfile official documentation NamedTemporaryFile TemporaryDirectory cleanup
  • Node.js fs official documentation streams file system
  • OWASP Path Traversal file path validation guide
  • CWE-22 Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory path traversal

Checked Sources

  • Python tempfile: https://docs.python.org/3/library/tempfile.html
  • Node.js fs: https://nodejs.org/api/fs.html
  • OWASP Path Traversal: https://owasp.org/www-community/attacks/Path_Traversal
  • CWE-22: https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/22

Weak Sources Ignored

  • Generic blogs, SEO-oriented security pages, old mirrored PDFs, and Reddit Q&A were not used as primary evidence for this requirement.

Plan Impact

  • Temporary artifacts require cleanup policy.
  • File stream/write handoffs require size bounds and validation.
  • Artifact paths are limited to workspace-relative paths and reject absolute paths, drive prefixes, backslashes, ~, and ...
  • mode=file or mode=artifact pipe edges must explicitly reference artifact_id.

Uncertainty

  • No actual runner exists yet, so file open/close, deletion, and stream backpressure measurement are out of scope for this change. A future runner must add real lifecycle and measurement checks through resource-guard-agent.

Public Decision Summary

File handoff is not just a path string. It should be part of the process graph as an artifact record with path boundary, size, producer/consumer, cleanup/retention, provenance, and validation so a future installable platform or local daemon can enforce the same rule.

CLI Pipeline 파일/아티팩트 Handoff 웹 검색 기록

검색 시간

  • 날짜: 2026-06-02
  • 작업 모드: governance

검색어

  • Python tempfile official documentation NamedTemporaryFile TemporaryDirectory cleanup
  • Node.js fs official documentation streams file system
  • OWASP Path Traversal file path validation guide
  • CWE-22 Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory path traversal

확인한 출처

  • Python tempfile: https://docs.python.org/3/library/tempfile.html
  • Node.js fs: https://nodejs.org/api/fs.html
  • OWASP Path Traversal: https://owasp.org/www-community/attacks/Path_Traversal
  • CWE-22: https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/22

약한 출처 제외

  • 일반 블로그, SEO성 보안 페이지, 오래된 PDF mirror, Reddit Q&A는 이번 요구사항의 핵심 근거로 쓰지 않았다.

계획 반영

  • temporary artifact는 cleanup policy를 필수로 둔다.
  • file stream/write는 크기 제한과 validation을 artifact 계약에 둔다.
  • path traversal 방지를 위해 artifact path는 workspace-relative로 제한하고 absolute path, drive prefix, backslash, ~, ..를 거부한다.
  • mode=file 또는 mode=artifact pipe는 artifact_id를 명시적으로 참조하게 한다.

불확실성

  • 실제 runner가 없으므로 파일 open/close, deletion, stream backpressure 측정은 이번 변경의 범위가 아니다. 추후 runner 구현 시 resource-guard-agent로 실제 lifecycle/measurement를 추가해야 한다.

공개 판단 요약

파일 handoff는 단순히 “출력 파일 경로를 하나 적는다”로 충분하지 않다. 프로세스 그래프의 일부로 artifact를 등록하고, 경로 경계, 크기, 생성자/소비자, 정리/보존, 출처, 검증을 함께 기록해야 나중에 설치형 플랫폼이나 local daemon이 같은 규칙을 강제할 수 있다.

documents.html:
CLI Pipeline File/Artifact Handoff Spec

Purpose

When CLI orchestration uses files, temp files, directories, caches, logs, or reports in addition to pipes, the platform needs explicit artifact contracts so implicit paths and temporary outputs do not bypass validation.

Requirement Links

  • REQ-WS-059
  • Related: REQ-WS-053, REQ-WS-057, REQ-WS-058

Scope

  • Add artifacts to CliPipelineInput.
  • Add artifact_id to PipelinePipe.
  • Require mode=file or mode=artifact pipes to reference an existing artifact.
  • Validate artifact kind, path, producer/consumer, size bound, format, cleanup/retention, provenance, and validation.
  • Require workspace-relative artifact paths and reject absolute paths, drive prefixes, backslashes, ~, and ...

Out Of Scope

  • Actual CLI process runner
  • Actual file I/O execution
  • File parser implementation
  • Runtime path resolution outside the workspace

documents.html:
CLI Pipeline File/Artifact Handoff Requirement Review

Review Target

  • REQ-WS-059
  • Related existing requirements: REQ-WS-053, REQ-WS-057, REQ-WS-058

Decision

This requirement extends, rather than replaces, REQ-WS-058. The existing requirement covers multi-CLI process graphs and pipe/fan-in merge gates. The new requirement adds path boundaries, cleanup/retention, provenance, and validation for file-based handoffs that could otherwise be implicit or unsafe.

Acceptance Criteria

  • check-cli-pipeline reads and validates artifacts.
  • mode=file or mode=artifact pipe edges fail when artifact_id is missing or references an unknown artifact.
  • Artifact paths must be workspace-relative and reject absolute paths, drive prefixes, backslashes, ~, and ...
  • Required artifacts need positive max_bytes and validation.
  • Temporary/cache artifacts need cleanup_policy.
  • Retained output/log/report/directory artifacts need retention_policy.

Out Of Scope

  • Implementing an actual multi-process runner
  • Actually creating or deleting files
  • Implementing per-CLI output parsers

CLI Pipeline File/Artifact Handoff Requirement Change

Change ID

  • REQ-WS-059
  • Date: 2026-06-02
  • Source request: UR-2026-06-02-014
  • Work mode: governance

Summary

After the previous pipe-oriented CLI orchestration request, the user added “files and etc.” This is interpreted as a requirement to explicitly manage files, temp files, directories, caches, logs, reports, and other artifact handoffs in addition to stdout/stderr/stdin pipes.

Requirement

When a CLI pipeline hands data off through a file or artifact, each handoff must record:

  • artifact_id
  • kind
  • workspace-relative path
  • producer/consumer process
  • size bound
  • format
  • cleanup or retention policy
  • provenance
  • validation

mode=file or mode=artifact pipe edges must reference artifact_id. Paths with absolute paths, drive prefixes, backslashes, ~, or .. require rework.

Evidence

  • Python tempfile official docs describe high-level temporary file/directory APIs with context managers and cleanup, while lower-level APIs require manual cleanup.
  • Node.js fs official docs describe file stream/write behavior and write sequencing risks.
  • OWASP Path Traversal and CWE-22 describe absolute path, ../, separator, and path input validation risks.

Affected Files

  • agent-platform/src/agent_platform/integrations/cli_pipeline.py
  • agent-platform/configs/integrations/cli-pipeline-template.json
  • agent-platform/docs/cli-pipeline-agent.en.md
  • _ops/workflows/71-cli-pipeline-orchestration.md
  • _ops/prompts/101-cli-pipeline-orchestration.md

변경 요약

사용자가 기존 pipe 중심 설명에 이어 “파일과 기타 등등”을 추가로 언급했다. 이를 multi-CLI orchestration에서 stdout/stderr/stdin pipe뿐 아니라 파일, 임시 파일, 디렉터리, cache, log, report, 기타 artifact handoff까지 명시적으로 관리하라는 요구로 해석했다.

CLI pipeline이 파일 또는 artifact로 데이터를 넘기면 각 handoff는 다음을 기록해야 한다.

  • artifact_id

documents.html:
CLI Adapter Policy

Purpose

Even as the platform becomes installable software, it must not become dependent on one CLI. The platform provides the workspace, history, documents, evaluations, settings, UI, and operating principles. External commands such as Codex CLI, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub CLI, package managers, and deployment CLIs are used through replaceable adapters when useful.

Core Principles

  • The installable app must not require a specific external CLI just to open, read, or navigate the workspace.
  • A CLI is an added capability, not the platform body.
  • The platform core owns intent and output contracts; CLI adapters translate them into provider-specific commands.
  • CLI adapters need availability checks, version checks, permission scopes, timeouts, output contracts, and fallbacks.
  • A missing CLI should become capability_missing, not a whole-platform failure.
  • Prefer argv-style execution, explicit cwd, timeouts, environment allowlists, and redacted stdout/stderr handling over shell strings.
  • If several CLIs run together, model the pipeline as a process graph instead of a shell string pipeline. Each CLI is a process node, stdout/stderr/stdin links are pipe edges, file/temp artifact/cache/log/report handoffs are artifact records, and fan-in behavior is a merge strategy.
  • If a desktop shell runs local commands, document command allowlists, workspace path allowlists, and user approval/settings boundaries first.
  • If a CLI becomes required, bundled, globally installed, or auto-installed, create an installation audit plan and rollback path first.

Source Of Truth

  • CLI adapter registry: agent-platform/configs/integrations/cli-adapter-registry.json
  • CLI pipeline template: agent-platform/configs/integrations/cli-pipeline-template.json

Examples

  • AI assistant CLIs: Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and Antigravity can be execution providers, but they are not the source of truth for platform principles.
  • Git/GitHub CLI: these can enrich history and remote work, but document/history browsing itself must not depend on gh.
  • Package managers: these can support installation or validation, but dependency state changes require installation audit records.
  • Deployment CLIs: Vercel, Docker, and cloud CLIs can be deployment adapters, but credential, target, rollback, and preview boundaries must be explicit.

documents.html:
CLI 어댑터 정책

목적

이 플랫폼은 설치형으로 발전하더라도 특정 CLI에 종속되지 않는다. 플랫폼은 작업 공간, 히스토리, 문서, 평가, 설정, UI, 운영 원칙을 제공하고, Codex CLI, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub CLI, package manager, 배포 CLI 같은 외부 명령은 필요할 때 교체 가능한 adapter로 사용한다.

핵심 원칙

  • 설치형 앱은 열리고 읽히고 탐색되는 데 특정 외부 CLI를 요구하지 않는다.
  • CLI는 플랫폼의 본체가 아니라 추가 능력이다.
  • 플랫폼 코어는 “무엇을 하려는지”와 출력 계약을 소유하고, CLI adapter는 그것을 provider별 명령으로 번역한다.
  • CLI adapter는 availability check, version check, permission scope, timeout, 출력 계약, fallback을 가져야 한다.
  • missing CLI는 전체 플랫폼 실패가 아니라 capability_missing으로 처리한다.
  • shell string 대신 argv-style 실행, 명시적 cwd, timeout, 환경변수 allowlist, stdout/stderr redaction을 기본으로 한다.
  • 여러 CLI를 한 번에 실행하면 shell string pipeline이 아니라 process graph로 모델링한다. 각 CLI는 process node, stdout/stderr/stdin 연결은 pipe edge, 파일/임시 아티팩트/캐시/로그/리포트 handoff는 artifact record, fan-in은 merge strategy로 기록한다.
  • desktop shell에서 로컬 명령을 실행하면 command allowlist, workspace path allowlist, 사용자 승인/설정 경계를 먼저 문서화한다.
  • CLI가 required, bundled, global install, auto-install 대상이 되면 설치 감사 계획과 rollback을 먼저 남긴다.

Source Of Truth

  • CLI adapter registry: agent-platform/configs/integrations/cli-adapter-registry.json
  • CLI pipeline template: agent-platform/configs/integrations/cli-pipeline-template.json
  • 설치형 앱 경계: platform-desktop-app/configs/desktop-distribution-registry.json
  • 설치 감사: _ops/workflows/58-installation-record.md
  • 제품화 정책: _docs/policies/installable-software-policy.ko.md

적용 예

  • AI assistant CLI: Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity는 실행 provider로 붙일 수 있지만 플랫폼 원칙의 원본이 아니다.
  • Git/GitHub CLI: history와 remote 작업을 도울 수 있지만 문서/히스토리 탐색 자체가 gh에 의존하면 안 된다.
  • package manager: 설치나 검증에 사용할 수 있지만 dependency 상태가 바뀌면 설치 감사 기록이 필요하다.
  • deployment CLI: Vercel, Docker, cloud CLI는 배포 adapter가 될 수 있지만 credential, target, rollback, preview 경계가 있어야 한다.
  • multi-CLI pipeline: source collector, planner, document converter 같은 여러 CLI를 연결할 수 있지만 cli-pipeline-agent가 process graph, pipe/artifact edge, workspace-relative path, timeout, output bound, cleanup/retention, merge strategy를 먼저 확인해야 한다.

검증

중요한 CLI adapter 설정을 만들거나 바꾸면 다음을 실행한다.


cd agent-platform
PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m agent_platform.cli check-config-contract configs/integrations/cli-adapter-registry.json
PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m agent_platform.cli check-config-contract configs/integrations/cli-pipeline-template.json
PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m agent_platform.cli check-cli-pipeline configs/integrations/cli-pipeline-template.json
